verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at docs.cockroachlabs.com that returns HTTP 200 with a structured index (probe-1). Markdown versions of doc pages are also served, and they point agents back to the llms.txt index (probe-2). The .md-suffixed docs URL for Continuum (docs-32) corroborates this agent-oriented doc format. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents actually using these docs, and evidence of how broadly the llms.txt and .md coverage spans the full documentation set.
